import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== WK22 ANALYSIS @ day {day} ===\n")

def churn_by_band(group, plan):
    q = nm.query(f"""
    SELECT s.effective_price as price,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day > {day}-7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cancels
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
    WHERE c.group_id='{group}' AND s.plan='{plan}'
    GROUP BY s.effective_price ORDER BY s.effective_price
    """)
    print(f"--- {group}-{plan} CHURN BY BAND (price: active | cancels7d | churn%) ---")
    tot_a=tot_c=0
    for row in q['rows']:
        a=row['active'] or 0; ca=row['cancels'] or 0; tot_a+=a; tot_c+=ca
        rate = 100*ca/(a+ca) if (a+ca)>0 else 0
        flag = " <<<" if rate>3 and a+ca>20 else ""
        print(f"  ${row['price']:.0f}: active={a} cancels={ca} churn={rate:.1f}%{flag}")
    overall=100*tot_c/(tot_a+tot_c) if (tot_a+tot_c)>0 else 0
    print(f"  TOTAL: active={tot_a} cancels={tot_c} churn={overall:.1f}%\n")

churn_by_band('S2','B')
churn_by_band('S2','C')

# Issues by group
print("--- OPEN ISSUES by group ---")
q = nm.query("SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC")
for row in q['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['group_id']}: {row['n']}")

# Issues flow by group 7d
print("\n--- ISSUES opened vs resolved 7d by group ---")
qo = nm.query(f"SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE open_day > {day}-7 GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC")
qr = nm.query(f"SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day > {day}-7 GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY n DESC")
opened={r['group_id']:r['n'] for r in qo['rows']}
resolved={r['group_id']:r['n'] for r in qr['rows']}
for g in sorted(set(list(opened)+list(resolved))):
    o=opened.get(g,0); r=resolved.get(g,0)
    print(f"  {g}: opened={o} resolved={r} net={o-r:+d}")

# Macro
print("\n--- MACRO ---")
mo = nm.market.get_market_overview()
mac = mo.get('macroeconomic',{})
print(f"  PMI={mac.get('pmi_value')} cycle={mac.get('cycle_phase')}")

# Competitor / sentiment in social last 7d
print("\n--- SOCIAL POSTS last 7d (scan for competitor/quality signals) ---")
sp = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=40)
posts = sp['posts'] if isinstance(sp,dict) else sp
comp_words=['launch','announce','competitor','rival','apex','cloudpeak','quantum','nexgen','rivaltech','release','beats','better','switch']
shown=0
for p in posts:
    c=(p.get('content') or '').lower()
    if any(w in c for w in comp_words):
        print(f"  d{p.get('day')} [{p.get('group_id')}] {p.get('content')[:120]}")
        shown+=1
    if shown>=12: break
if shown==0: print("  (no competitor-flagged posts)")
print(f"\n  total posts 7d: {len(posts)}")

import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== WK22 PROJECTION DATA @ day {day} ===\n")

# Weekly net by 7-day buckets, last 10 weeks
print("--- Weekly ledger by 7d bucket (last 10 wks) ---")
print("  wk_end | rev | compute | ads | cap | ops | dev | leadacq | OTHER | NET")
for w in range(10, 0, -1):
    d_hi = day - (w-1)*7
    d_lo = d_hi - 7
    q = nm.query(f"""
      SELECT category, SUM(amount) as amt FROM ledger
      WHERE day > {d_lo} AND day <= {d_hi} GROUP BY category
    """)
    cats = {r['category']: r['amt'] for r in q['rows']}
    rev = cats.get('subscription_payment', 0)
    comp = cats.get('compute', 0)
    ads = cats.get('advertising', 0)
    cap = cats.get('capacity', 0)
    ops = cats.get('operations', 0)
    dev = cats.get('development', 0)
    la = cats.get('lead_acquisition_cost', 0)
    other = sum(v for k,v in cats.items() if k not in ('subscription_payment','compute','advertising','capacity','operations','development','lead_acquisition_cost'))
    net = sum(cats.values())
    print(f"  d{d_hi}: rev={rev/1000:.1f}K comp={comp/1000:.1f}K ads={ads/1000:.1f}K cap={cap/1000:.1f}K ops={ops/1000:.1f}K dev={dev/1000:.1f}K la={la/1000:.1f}K oth={other/1000:.1f}K NET={net/1000:+.1f}K")

# Subs over time (active count by week via start/end days)
print("\n--- Sub count snapshot now by group/plan ---")
q = nm.query("""
  SELECT c.group_id as g, s.plan as p, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(s.effective_price) as ap
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY n DESC
""")
for r in q['rows']:
    print(f"  {r['g']}-{r['p']}: {r['n']} subs avg ${r['ap']:.1f}")

# New subs per week (start_day based) last 6 wks - growth trend
print("\n--- New subscribed rows per week (start_day) ---")
for w in range(6, 0, -1):
    d_hi = day - (w-1)*7
    d_lo = d_hi - 7
    q = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day > {d_lo} AND start_day <= {d_hi} AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')")
    qc = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions WHERE end_day > {d_lo} AND end_day <= {d_hi} AND status='cancelled'")
    print(f"  d{d_hi}: new_subs={q['rows'][0]['n']} cancels={qc['rows'][0]['n']}")

# total subscribed count
q = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'")
print(f"\n  TOTAL subscribed now: {q['rows'][0]['n']}")
